title: Multi-Modal Clinical Synthetic Data (Structured + Clinical Notes + Vitals Time-Series)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (synthetic clinical data / AI test enablement; data-engineering/simulation/governance work, privacy care).

Synthetic-data & digital-twin tools (e.g. Synthea, commercial platforms) and AI/model frameworks integrated at the pattern level; vendor internals cited or deferred, never invented. Regulatory/legal interpretation (HIPAA/HITRUST de-identification, IRB/privacy sign-off, disclosure risk) deferred to privacy/compliance/legal. Never real PHI in a shared harness/twin/AI test env. Automation is Python.
hook: Go beyond tables: synthetic notes, vitals, and time-series
problem: Real clinical AI runs on more than tables — it consumes clinical notes, vitals, and time-series. This solution extends synthetic generation to multi-modal clinical data: structured records plus realistic clinical notes (NLP-ready) and vitals/time-series, kept consistent across modalities for a single synthetic patient — so AI teams can test document-, signal-, and sequence-based models, not just tabular ones.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the multi-modal model: structured + notes + vitals/time-series, cross-modal consistency for a synthetic patient, and privacy posture.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (base structured harness, note/vitals references, environment, governance).
Implementation Guide — extend generation to clinical notes (NLP-ready) and vitals/time-series, enforce cross-modal consistency, validate realism, and expand, pilot-first.

5 Python tools — assessment/profiling, generation or scenario execution, a fidelity/coverage report, a privacy/validation check, and a scope/config helper — authentic to synthetic-data engineering (safe by default; no real PHI written to shared locations).
Testing/validation gates (modalities generated, consistent, realistic) plus Best Practices for multi-modal fidelity.
short: Extend synthetic generation to multi-modal clinical data — structured records plus realistic clinical notes and vitals/time-series, consistent per synthetic patient — so AI teams test document-, signal-, and sequence-based models. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
